messages:
maya: quick q — PR #4567 updates the /v1/complete response to include more served_model provenance. if a caller sends both model_id and model_hint, which should we guarantee to serve? also how do region_hint + tier_hint affect fallback order? planning to merge to canary tomorrow AM.

sam: model_id wins by default. model_hint is a soft preference used only when model_id is omitted or unschedulable.

sam: short notes on routing: region_hint filters the pool of candidate hosts (we don't route outside requested region unless explicitly allowed). tier_hint shifts priority (premium/dedicated pools preferred) but it does NOT trump a pinned model_id.

kevin: small nuance — if model_id is explicitly requested but cannot be served (no compatible variant in that region/tier) we attempt family fallbacks. fallback precedence we follow is: exact model_id -> variant (e.g., quantized/8-bit variant) -> family-compatible architecture -> cross-arch best-effort -> default-fallback-model. we should lock this into the API contract.

olivia: another big one: current SDKs expect served_model as a string (e.g., "bloomz-7b"). PR #4567 moves us to a richer object. that will break older clients.

maya: that's the concern. we have user apps pinned to parsing served_model string. can't break them silently.

sam: proposal: keep a backward-compatible string field served_model (stable) and add served_model_meta (object) with structured fields: id, variant, source, fallback_reason. example: 

```json
{
  "generated_text": "...",
  "served_model": "bloomz-7b",
  "served_model_meta": {
    "id": "bloomz-7b",
    "variant": "quant-8",
    "source": "fallback-family",
    "fallback_reason": "variant_unavailable_in_region"
  }
}
```

kevin: +1. also add an X-Served-Model-Version response header so telemetry can safely detect schema changes.

dev-bot: PR #4567 — canary build started https://ci.redwood/4567 :building:

olivia: I'll add a small integration test asserting served_model string still exists for legacy clients and that served_model_meta is present for newer ones. will push to the branch.

maya: can we also document the exact fallback precedence and clarify how region_hint/tier_hint are honored? I'll update the API ref and Console docs to show examples.

kevin: pinging infra: @oncall-router can we ensure routing metrics surface fallback_reason as a tag so SLO dashboards can break down fallbacks? (no action needed here except acknowledgement)

sam: agreed — tests + docs + telemetry tags are the merge checklist.

maya: thanks everyone. please comment on PR if you have any objections. plan: merge to canary if no blockers by 09:00 PT tomorrow. :pray:
